jobs.name: Scout
jobs.jobLine: I watch the harbour and check every boat that brings messages into town.

introLines: I check each boat's name and flag before it docks.
I can't keep up… will you help?
days.successLine: That one said it was from the bank, but the name had a zero in it!
days.snatchLine: But it looked just like a post boat…
days.backupLine: I'll take the lookout. Show me how!

introLines: Some of these look almost right. Read carefully!
days.successLine: The name was right, but the sender wasn't. Sneaky!
days.snatchLine: But it looked just like Coach…
days.backupLine: I'll take the lookout. Show me how!
days.waitingLine: Finally! The boats piled up while you were at the gate!
days.complaintFailLine: Nobody trusts the lookout any more, so the attackers walked right in.

jobs.name: Gigi
jobs.jobLine: I keep the list of who may come in, and which door they use.

introLines: Everyone needs the right door, and the list says who's welcome.
days.successLine: Door 23 has been shut for years. Nobody honest asks for it.
days.snatchLine: They walked right through the old door…
days.backupLine: I'll keep the gate. Show me the list!

introLines: If they're not on my list, they don't come in.
days.successLine: Saying 'Gigi knows me' doesn't put you on my list!
days.backupLine: I'll keep the gate. Show me the list!
days.waitingLine: There you are! The queue went all the way to the bridge.
days.complaintLine: That was Luca! He's on the list.
days.complaintFailLine: Friends stopped coming, and the gate got careless.

jobs.name: Uno and Due
jobs.jobLine: Uno checks the password. Due checks with the owner's phone. You need both of us.

introLines: Due: I check the owner's phone. We need both!
days.successLine: Right password, wrong code. That's why there are two of us!
days.snatchLine: Uno: The password was right… Due: But the code wasn't!
days.backupLine: I'll stand by the vault. Two checks, got it!

jobs.name: Patch
jobs.jobLine: When the builders send new parts, I fit them before the old cracks get bigger.

days.successLine: Fixed before they found it. That's why I never say 'later'.
days.snatchLine: The Worm found the crack first…
days.backupLine: I'll fix the wall. Pass me the bricks!

intro: Every message, photo and password you send passes through Byte World.
The Bytes who live here make sure it all gets where it's going.

dayEnd.speaker: gigi
dayEnd.title: Day 1 done
dayEnd.line: You learn fast. Tomorrow they'll come two at a time.

dayEnd.speaker: patch
dayEnd.title: Day 2 done
dayEnd.line: They learned all our tricks. Tomorrow we rebuild the town.

dayStart.title: Day 1
dayStart.line: A quiet morning in Byte World.

dayStart.speaker: scout
dayStart.title: Day 2
dayStart.line: Busy dock again. I'll need sharper eyes today.

collapse: No Bytes were left to do the work, and the attackers took over.
peace: Built it ourselves, and built it right. Back to work, everyone!

build.speaker: patch
intro: Today we rebuild the town's network ourselves, and this time we build it right.
build.failNoPath: That house isn't connected. The message got lost!
build.failWrongHouse: That message went to the wrong house.

ui.tagline: A tiny world living inside your Wi-Fi
